message.content:
This document is a README for **Project Maya**, a system for running large open models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) locally on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Models & Quantization**
- Three model families with Maya quants (XS/S/M/L sizes) ranging ~75 GB to ~470 GB; run on NVIDIA (V100/RTX 20+), AMD (RX 7900, Radeon AI PRO, Strix Halo), and experimentally Apple Metal.
